items.name: Harland Williams
items.caption:
The Half Baked scene-stealer and Harland Highway podcast host returns to stand-up.
Harland Williams performs at Punch Line Houston on January 22, 2027. He has also appeared in Dumb and Dumber and There's Something About Mary. Tickets on sale now. Link in bio.
